input_messages.content: Hey, I just got out of the Q3 goal planning meeting. Man, I have to complain—that OKR review template in the spreadsheet was incredibly hard to format.

Yep! We got sidetracked because we literally spent time discussing the font size used in the OKR review presentation deck. But we finally got to the core stuff. Today, July 7th, Boss Zhang made the final call during the OKR review that the multiplayer mode will be our top priority for Q3.

I am! It's going to be a lot of work, but I'm glad we finally have a concrete direction. I'll start mapping out the initial gameplay loops tomorrow.

Hey, let's update my notes from the OKR review today. Since Boss Zhang made multiplayer our top priority for Q3, Wanghao and I had to figure out the technical breakdown.
You got it! What did you and Wanghao decide on for the technical goals?
Well, Wanghao concluded in the OKR review that the server latency must be reduced by 20 milliseconds. Honestly, he felt pretty tired after sitting through the entire OKR review.
Noted the 20ms latency reduction. And yeah, those marathon OKR meetings can be super draining. Did he set any capacity targets?
Yeah, he established the OKR review technical target of supporting 500 concurrent users per shard. After we finished, I promised Wanghao I would buy him lunch to celebrate surviving the OKR review.
500 concurrent users per shard is on the books. Lunch sounds like a well-deserved reward! Did you guys get to relax a bit?
A little bit. We mostly just chatted about the snacks provided during the OKR review break. The pastries were surprisingly good this time!

input_messages.content: Hey, I just talked to Liwei about that Shenzhen trip Boss Zhang put me in charge of next month. Man, she got visibly upset when she realized it overlaps with our anniversary.

Will do! I'll add the noise-canceling headphones to your packing list. Hang in there with Liwei, you've got this.
Hey, I just got off the phone with my Mom. We were catching up about that Shenzhen trip Boss Zhang has me leading next month.
Oh nice, how's she doing? Did she have any advice for the trip?
She's doing well. She actually mentioned her neighbor went to Shenzhen recently and complained non-stop about the traffic there.
Typical neighbor gossip! Are you flying or taking the train down there?
We actually discussed that. We debated high-speed rail versus flying, but I'm leaning toward flying since I told her the exact dates are in mid-August.
Makes sense for mid-August, flying is probably faster. Did she give you the usual mom reminders?
Of course she did. She reminded me to pack an umbrella since it'll probably rain a lot. Oh, and I promised her I'd buy her this specific silk scarf she's been wanting while I'm on the Shenzhen trip.

Exactly. But I feel a little better having a plan. Sister Chen even recommended a reliable moving company we can use once the apartment hunting is done. She's really thinking ahead for us.
Sister Chen sounds like an amazing friend to have in your corner right now. Just take it one step at a time, and don't let those rent prices overwhelm you!
Hey, just got back from the badminton session with Jiange. We went pretty hard today, he even said his shoulder was a bit sore afterwards.
Sounds like an intense match! Hope his shoulder recovers quickly. Are you guys still planning to play next weekend?
Yeah, but we're changing the schedule. Jiange arranged for the next badminton session to be moved to Sunday at 2:00 PM instead of our usual Saturday morning slot.

Wow, that's a tight turnaround! Down to just two days from four. How are you and Wanghao going to squeeze the server load tests into that window?

It's going to be a massive rush. Honestly, during the meeting, Boss Zhang just complained about the terrible airline food usually served on the Shenzhen trip. Like that's our biggest problem right now.
Ha, classic Boss Zhang priorities. Well, at least it's a shorter trip so you won't have to endure the food for long.

True. He also mentioned the rainy weather forecast for the Shenzhen trip, which sounds miserable. Do you think I should even bother packing a suit for the Shenzhen trip if it's just two days of rain and running between servers?

Yeah, please update the calendar. I'll just prep for a very crammed 48 hours.
Done! Your itinerary is updated for the two-day sprint. Let me know if you need help organizing any docs before you fly out.
Hey, can you help me prep my notes for the server migration? Since Boss Zhang cut the Shenzhen trip back to exactly two days to save budget, Wanghao and I are scrambling a bit.
Sure thing! Two days is definitely a tight window. What do you need to jot down for the migration prep?
Well, Wanghao just concluded that the database migration during the Shenzhen trip will require 150GB of temporary storage. We need to make sure DevOps provisions that beforehand.
Got it. I've logged the 150GB temporary storage requirement for the database migration. Did he mention any other technical specs?

No, that was the main technical takeaway. After that, Wanghao just joked about bringing his heavy mechanical keyboard on the Shenzhen trip. I told him he's crazy, especially since I was just looking at my own carry-on luggage and realizing it might be too small for the trip.
Haha, packing a heavy mechanical keyboard in a tiny carry-on sounds like a hassle! Are you guys going to be stuck in the server room the whole time, or will you get a break?
Mostly stuck in the server room, but Wanghao did ask where we should eat authentic dim sum during the Shenzhen trip. We'll definitely try to squeeze that in.
